nodes.condition: in.Phase != ReportReported && in.Phase != ReportSkipped and proposal == nil

nodes.condition: in.Phase != ReportReported && in.Phase != ReportSkipped and !(proposal == nil)

nodes.condition: !(in.Phase != ReportReported && in.Phase != ReportSkipped) and  == record != nil && repeats(*record, proposal, in)

nodes.name: rpcResult
nodes.condition: !(in.Phase != ReportReported && in.Phase != ReportSkipped) and  == record == nil || record.Status != ReviewWaitingAgent || comm.Must(ActiveReview.Get(ctx)) != in.ReviewID

nodes.name: rpcResult
nodes.condition: !(in.Phase != ReportReported && in.Phase != ReportSkipped) and  == in.Defect != nil

nodes.name: rpcResult
nodes.condition: !(in.Phase != ReportReported && in.Phase != ReportSkipped) and in.Proposal != nil and refusal != ""

metadata.explanation: Wait up to 24 hours for the agent's report, which cancels the wait; without it the review expires.
Wait for the next scheduled review, then start it, or record it skipped while another review runs.
Read the Project's current Live deployment, and with valid goals of its build delete the exports of earlier reviews beyond the kept ones; delete the stored documents of pruned proposals.

Store the goals of the newest Live revision, or the read failure, restart the schedule they set, move proposals live or undone by the commits the build holds, and begin again the review that waited for them.
Complete the Flow of a deleting Project after its Steps were cancelled; the Project's deletion removes the evolve objects.
Refuse a manifest that is not this review's export of the Live runs, evaluate the copied goals over the export's runs, write metrics.json beside it and keep the goal values for the review.
Export one part: page the Live engine's search, read and compact up to 500 runs at a paced rate, write the part and continue with the next.
Write the export's manifest once: its window, parts, run count, truncation and the Live release timeline up to the review's start.
Record the export and goal values; outside review access the review ends measured, otherwise it waits for the agent.
Tell the Project's Session of a person's decision on a proposal; one it cannot take goes to RecordNotifyFailure.

Read .superverse/goals.md at the Live build's commit through the repository host and parse it, check which applied or live proposals the build holds, and whether the build Live ran before held those going live. A superseded revision begins again the review that waited.
Mark a decision the Session could not take, so Studio asks the person to tell the agent in the chat.
Record a review whose Step failed or ran past its wait limit as failed, or skipped when its Session cannot take it, with its code and the redacted cause, and clear the active review.

Remove the pruned proposals and make long-undone approvals stale; mark the deleted exports; adopt a newer current Live and read its goals first; record the review skipped, or copy the goals and the window into it and start the export.
Tell the Project's Session that the review waits for the agent, polling while its queue is full; a Session that cannot take it skips the review.
